components.name: Button
components.semantics: Use a native button for actions and an anchor for navigation. Do not use a clickable div.
accessibility: Use the disabled attribute for unavailable native buttons.

components.name: Card
components.semantics: Use an article or section when the content has a meaningful heading; otherwise use a neutral container.

components.name: Badge
components.semantics: Use concise text. Do not communicate status by color alone.

components.name: Form controls
components.semantics: Use native inputs and selects. Associate every control with a label using for/id or an enclosing label.
accessibility: Connect hint and error text with aria-describedby.

components.name: Alert
components.semantics: Use role=alert only for urgent dynamically inserted messages; use role=status for non-urgent updates.

components.name: Layout utilities
components.semantics: Use layout utilities for composition, not to replace semantic document structure.

components.name: Tabs
components.semantics: Use only for layered views where switching panels is useful. Otherwise prefer links or disclosure elements.
markupContract: Each tab has role=tab, aria-controls, aria-selected and a stable id.
Each panel has role=tabpanel and aria-labelledby.
Inactive panels use the native hidden attribute.

components.name: Accordion
components.semantics: Use native details and summary elements; no library JavaScript is required.

components.name: Dialog
components.semantics: Use the native dialog element. Provide an accessible title and a visible close/cancel action.
keyboard: Native modal dialog supports Escape to close.
Focus returns to the opening trigger after close.

components.name: Tooltip
components.semantics: Supplementary information only. Essential instructions must remain visible outside the tooltip.

components.name: Visually hidden utility
components.semantics: Use for screen-reader text and skip links. It becomes visible when focused or active.
